notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Critical Bug Fixed! 🎉
notes.notes:
A bug preventing some players from starting a new game or accessing the save menu options has been fixed in the latest update.

Apologies to anyone who experienced issues or had a bad experience due to this problem. Thank you for your understanding and patience.

For anyone still encountering issues, the Community Hub is available for support. Feedback is always appreciated to ensure the best possible experience.

Thank you for playing The Mirror's Curse!
